impact: CLAUDE.md's Edge-cut note says app/Actions/* is 'untouched and unreferenced by the app' at ~330 files. It is 380 files and 10 files outside it import from it, including app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php and Auth/Register.php. Any session that trusts the note and deletes the directory breaks login and registration. Verified 2026-09-04 with a fixed-string grep; an earlier over-escaped regex is what produced the false zero.
resolution: 2026-09-11: CLAUDE.md now states that app/Actions holds five plain classes used by Login/Register/Security/SourceControl/org settings; the rest of the Actions framework (~375 files) was deleted per ruling r-f6dq42jw0h1r0h87.
title: CLAUDE.md wrongly states app/Actions/* is unreferenced
